title: 第17章 凉望津同学想要回答问题呢第18章 这的人都好卷压力山大
slug: 开局逼我献祭我有天道赐福
content_zh:
来人穿着一身灰白花色的修士服，睡眼惺忪，花白的头发很是凌乱。
万象先生李知渊，传功殿长老，是青云道院内资历最老的存在，博览群书，广游天下数百年，精通万法并不专修一门。
早年间伤了根基，修为再难精进，从那以后他的重点便全都放在了理论研究上，五百年前被青云道院当时的院长邀请来青云道院任职，一直到今天。
这些都是温郗昨天在图书馆的时候看到的，她找到了一本《启明洲名人轶事录》，想着提前了解一下自己的老师便看完了李知渊的介绍。
李知渊走上前方的台子，直接切入正题——
“我是李知渊，你们可以喊我万象先生，也可以喊我李长老。没什么可做自我介绍的，我只说一句——”
“你们有什么不明白的，都可以来找我。”
“至于你们的名字，我已经记住了，所以我们直接开始上课。在你们中有些人的家境较好，或许已经引气入体开始了基础的修炼，有的人可能并不认识修士，至今都没引气入体。”
“这些都没关系，我会细致地向你们讲解如何引气入体，当然，这些放在最后，以免耽误那些已经成功引气入体的弟子的时间。”
“在你们入院的一个月内，我会向你们介绍六种道法的基本常识。虽然你们在筑基后会选择一门道法进行专修，但别的相关常识也要有所了解。我们青云道院出去的弟子虽说不至于个个都是镇守一方的强者，也不能被小孩问到一些小问题的时候胡说八道……”
李知渊在上面讲着，凉望津仗着位置在后面，悄悄后移靠近身后的温郗。
注意到他的动作，萧杙微微皱眉，搭在桌面上的手蜷了蜷。
温郗早就发现了凉望津的动作，双手环臂好整以暇地等着这小孩的下一个动作。
凉望津转过身来，压着声音开口：“喂，我可是已经打听到了，萧温郗，听说你入院前灵根一直没觉醒，肯定都还没引气入体吧？”
温郗一愣：“你怎么知道的？”
系统曾告诉过她，为了让她更适应这里，温郗的设定是流落在外十三年，去年才被顾千远找到带回皇宫。
由于她身子偏弱灵根又一直没觉醒，顾千远将她的一切事情都瞒得很好。整个天启国也只是知道有个昭舒公主，其余的就连她的名字都不知道。
这凉望津是从哪打听到消息的？
温郗眯起眼睛，默默偏头看向坐在自己另一边的鹿辞霜。
鹿辞霜圆脸一红，清澈的杏眼带上了羞恼：“对不起——他，他套我话，我当时，当时……”

怎么办，她也不好意思说自己是在大肆夸奖温郗的时候，一时没留意被套了话……
温郗收回视线：“没事。”
也不是什么大事，而且既然已经发生了，没必要跟这世界里的角色计较。
——————
鹿辞霜瘪了瘪嘴，更加不好意思，她狠狠瞪了一眼凉望津，咬牙切齿地做了个抹脖子的动作。
他就等着她跟他约决斗台吧，看她不打死他！
凉望津“哼”了一声，小嘴还在叭叭个没完：“要我说，你这个天赋觉醒的太晚了，凉琮知道吗？就是我们入院考核第一天的负责人，那是我姑姑，我姑姑可是出生的时候灵根就觉醒了，虽然她灵根值没我高，但我还是最佩服她……”
“你这种起步都算很晚了，天赋再好一时半会也赶不上去，天启皇室到底是怎么培养你的——”
鹿辞霜忍无可忍：“吵死了，你能不能闭嘴。”
凉望津被鹿辞霜这么一骂，更来劲了：“嘿，我还偏要说，你能拿我怎么办？”
温郗：……
她真服了，鹿辞霜跟凉望津比起来都算得上稳重了。
这时，李知渊已经讲到了青云道院主要教导的五种主要道法大类，也是五位峰主的主修——剑修，阵修，体修，医修，器修。
李知渊：“那有没有人愿意分享一下自己对这五种主修道法的观点？”
凉望津没注意到台上李知渊的停顿，还在压着声音说小话：“要我说啊，萧温郗你就大大方方地跟着我学，我从小就看我两个姑姑练功，见识很广——”
温郗淡定举手：“李长老，凉望津一直在下面想要回答问题呢，我都听到他说了好多观点了，但可能是有点不好意思举手。”
凉望津：！
温郗好听的嗓音空灵又纯净，在教室里骤然响起，瞬间引来了所有人的注目。
凉望津回头狠狠瞪着温郗，温郗又是柔柔一笑。
凉望津：……
content_en:
The visitor was wearing a gray and white monk's uniform, his eyes were sleepy, and his gray hair was very messy.
Mr. Wanxiang Li Zhiyuan, the elder of Chuan Gong Hall, is the oldest person in Qingyun Taoist Academy. He is well-read and has traveled around the world for hundreds of years. He is proficient in all kinds of methods without specializing in one.
His foundation was damaged in his early years, and it was difficult to improve his cultivation. Since then, his focus has been entirely on theoretical research. Five hundred years ago, he was invited by the then dean of Qingyun Taoist Temple to serve in Qingyun Taoist Temple, where he has been until today.
Wen Xi saw these when she was in the library yesterday. She found a book called "Anecdotes of Famous People in Qimingzhou" and read Li Zhiyuan's introduction, thinking about getting to know her teacher in advance.
Li Zhiyuan walked up to the stage in front and got straight to the point——
"I am Li Zhiyuan, you can call me Mr. Wanxiang, or you can call me Elder Li. I have nothing to introduce myself, I just want to say -"
"If you don't understand anything, you can come to me."
"As for your names, I have already memorized them, so we will start the class directly. Some of you are from better families and may have already introduced qi into your body to start basic practice. Some of you may not know the monks and have not introduced qi into your body yet."
"It doesn't matter. I will explain to you how to introduce Qi into the body in detail. Of course, I will put this at the end so as not to waste the time of those disciples who have successfully introduced Qi into the body."
"Within one month after you are admitted to the hospital, I will introduce you to the basic common sense of the six Taoist methods. Although you will choose one Taoist method to specialize in after establishing the foundation, you must also understand other related common sense. Although not all of our disciples from Qingyun Taoist Academy will be strong men guarding one side, we cannot talk nonsense when children ask some trivial questions..."
Li Zhiyuan was talking on top, while Liang Wangjin took advantage of his position at the back and quietly moved back to get closer to Wen Xi who was behind him.
Noticing his movements, Xiao Zhu frowned slightly and curled up his hand on the table.
Wen Xi had noticed Liang Wangjin's movements a long time ago. He crossed his arms and waited for the child's next move.
Liang Wangjin turned around and spoke in a low voice: "Hey, I've already heard about it, Xiao Wenxi. I heard that your spiritual roots were not awakened before you were admitted to the hospital. You must not have introduced Qi into your body, right?"
Wen Xi was stunned: "How did you know?"
The system had told her that in order to make her more adaptable here, Wen Xi was set to live outside for thirteen years before being found and brought back to the palace by Gu Qianyuan last year.
Since her body was weak and her spiritual roots had not yet awakened, Gu Qianyuan kept everything about her a secret. The entire Tianqi Kingdom only knew that there was Princess Zhaoshu, and the rest didn't even know her name.
Where did Liang Wangjin get the news?
Wen Xi narrowed his eyes and silently turned his head to look at Lu Cishuang sitting on the other side of him.
Lu Cishuang's round face turned red, and her clear almond eyes were filled with embarrassment: "I'm sorry - he, he tricked me, I was, at that time..."
No matter what, she was embarrassed to say that she was praising Wen Xi and didn't notice that she was tricked...
Wen Xi looked away: "It's okay."
It's not a big deal, and since it has already happened, there is no need to worry about the characters in this world.
——————
Lu Cishuang pursed her lips and became even more embarrassed. She glared at Liang Wangjin fiercely, gritted her teeth and made a motion of wiping her neck.
He just waits for her to make an appointment with him for a duel, and see if she doesn't beat him to death!
Liang Wangjin snorted, and kept chattering: "Let me tell you, your talent awakened too late, does Liang Cong know? The person in charge of our first day of admission assessment is my aunt. My aunt's spiritual roots were awakened when she was born. Although her spiritual roots are not as high as mine, I still admire her the most..."
"You are starting very late. No matter how talented you are, you won't be able to catch up in a while. TianqiHow did the royal family train you——"
Lu Cishuang couldn't bear it anymore: "It's so noisy, can you shut up. "
Liang Wangjin got even more excited when Lu Cishuang scolded him like this: "Hey, I still want to say, what can you do to me? "
Wen Xi:......
She was really convinced. Lu Cishuang was considered stable compared to Liang Wangjin.
At this time, Li Zhiyuan had already talked about the five main categories of Taoism taught by Qingyun Taoist Academy, which are also the main trainings of the five peak masters - sword cultivation, formation cultivation, physical cultivation, medical cultivation, and weapon cultivation.
Li Zhiyuan: "Is anyone willing to share your views on these five major Taoist practices? "
Liang Wangjin didn't notice Li Zhiyuan's pause on the stage, and was still talking in a low voice: "If you ask me, Xiao Wenxi, just follow me and learn from me. I have watched my two aunts practice Kung Fu since I was a child, and I am very knowledgeable-"
Wen Xi calmly raised his hand: "Elder Li, Liang Wangjin has been downstairs trying to answer questions. I have heard him say a lot of points, but he may be a little embarrassed to raise his hand. "
Liang Wangjin:!
Wen Xi's beautiful voice, ethereal and pure, suddenly sounded in the classroom, instantly attracting everyone's attention.
Liang Wangjin turned around and glared at Wen Xi fiercely, and Wen Xi smiled softly again.
Liang Wangjin:......
